messages:
andrew: heads-up, seeing persistent p95 tail (~18ms) for short RPCs on rack r99 when tenant-302 spikes small inference calls. baseline ~3ms, started ~00:40 UTC. grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/egress/r99

devops-bot: [Alert] egress-p95-pedestal on r99 at 00:42 UTC. linked runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/egress-noise

maria: any obvious top-sender? tcpdumps or tx stats? could be sidecar telemetry or tiny-req fanout causing NIC coalesce thrash.

andrew: quick host dump from r99-node2:
```
tx_queue_len: 46
p95_rtt_ms: 18.1
irq_rate_pps: 102000
softirq_skew: cpu1
top_tx_owner: tenant-302-sidecar (pid 7701)
```

kevin: low-friction path: 1) apply irq-affinity spread to affected hosts, 2) if p95 still >5ms, soft-throttle tenant cgroup (tc qdisc classify by cgroup), 3) if recurring, handoff tenant to a micro-slice (prewarmed micro-proxy+reserved tiny slice) as a mid-cost isolation. micro-slice is cheaper than full dedicated GPU carveout but isolates L7 and some host resources.

anya: I'll run irq spread then apply a canary tc throttle. cmd I used elsewhere: `tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30; tc class add ...; tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1:0 prio 1 handle 100 cgroup`

devops-bot: Action queued: apply-irq-spread -> r99-node[1-3] (00:49 UTC)

anya: IRQ spread applied. p95 dropped to 6.8ms, tx_queue_len -> 20. still above baseline but much better. applying per-tenant soft-throttle for tenant-302 on node2 as a canary: 120mbit burst 12ms.

andrew: after throttle p95 -> 3.5ms on canary host. looks like combined play did it.

maria: thanks. can we add an auto-attr field to the alert pipeline so future egress-p95 alerts show top-cgroup/pid and suggest the play automatically?

kevin: filing INFRA-9001: auto-attribution + soft-quarantine runbook + micro-slice cost appendix. maria/finance please add micro-slice vs dedicated-slice numbers.

finance: quick note: micro-slice (prewarmed proxy + small host reservation) ~1.25x marginal cost during peak vs shared; dedicated GPU slice ~2.5x due to reservation headroom and replicas. will add detailed appendix to INFRA-9001.

andrew: leaving monitors on for 45m, will attach tcpdumps and the tc commands to the ticket. nice quick win. :white_check_mark:
